name: Rocket Racer

specialAbility.name: Rocket Launch
specialAbility.description: Fires up twin rocket boosters and blasts to maximum speed — nothing in the arena can outrun this!

lore: Rocket Racer strapped two actual rocket engines to its back and said 'let's GO!' This sleek white-and-red speed machine is the fastest truck in the rare class, and when it hits Rocket Launch mode, flames shoot out the back and it turns into a blur! It moves so fast the announcer can't even keep up. Ready, set, WHOOOOSH!
